title: Replace a general construction induction card (white card)
summary: You can order and pay for a replacement general construction induction card (white card) online if your details match those on your card.
intro:
Workers on construction sites must have a SafeWork NSW general construction induction card, known as a white card.

If your white card has been lost, stolen, damaged or destroyed you can order and pay for a replacement online if your details match those on your card.

The replacement card will be sent to your postal address.

### Before you start

If your address or contact details have changed do not start your application until you complete the update contact details form.

To check your white card number and details visit Verify NSW.
who_can_apply: You must have already been issued a white card.
Your details must match those on your card.
what_you_need: A credit or debit card to pay the replacement fee.
If your card contains errors, you need to call 13 10 50.

how_to_steps.text: Follow the prompts to apply for a replacement card.
